header.title: We are the largest flower base in the region!
header.desc: Oasis Cash&Carry has been a supplier of flowers, plants and accessories from leading global manufacturers to the Russian market for decades and one of the largest wholesale bases for the flower business in the Moscow region. Here you will find everything for the flower businness. We supply flowers, plants and accessories from Holland, Italy, Germany, Spain, Israel, USA, China, Turkey, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Ecuador, Costa Rica, Colombia, Ethiopia, Uganda, Kenya and others. In addition, the warehouse always has products for plant care: soil and soil mixtures, mineral and organic fertilizers, top dressing at wholesale prices. For owners of flower shops and florists, a large assortment of accessories for creating bouquets is presented.
